credentials: California acupuncture license #17220. NCCAOM Board-Certified Diplomate. M.A. in Traditional Chinese Medicine from Yo San University (2015), and a B.A. from UCLA. In practice since 2016, and the only practitioner at the clinic. Head Chinese Medicine Writer for Global Tea Hut magazine.
address: 2116 N Glenoaks Blvd, Ste 3, Burbank, CA 91504
hours: By appointment. Open times show in the booking calendar.
payment: Payment is taken when you book your time. Nothing is booked until payment goes through.
also: Chinese herbal medicine, cupping, moxibustion, and therapeutic massage are also offered. A fee for those is not listed on the site. Text the clinic and ask.
teaSitsBlurb: Weekly tea sits are an hour of tea, mostly in silence, with six seats. Dates are on the tea sits page.

series.name: Five Element Rejuvenation™
series.summary: Five Element Rejuvenation™ is a five-session journey through Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, and Water, with red light therapy included. You can take it as cosmetic acupuncture, nanoneedling, or microneedling. Book all five and the fifth is free.

services.name: Microneedling
services.short: Collagen induction therapy with custom serums and red light therapy. For fine lines, acne scars, uneven texture, and thinning hair.

services.name: Nanoneedling
services.short: A gentle surface treatment with custom serums and red light therapy. No downtime. For glow, hydration, and sensitive skin.

services.name: Cosmetic Acupuncture
services.short: Facial acupuncture at tension-releasing and lifting points, combined with constitutional body points. Red light therapy included.

services.name: Acupuncture: Initial Treatment
services.short: A detailed intake, a treatment plan, and your first acupuncture treatment.

services.name: Acupuncture: Repeat Treatment
services.short: Acupuncture treatment following your plan from the initial intake.

services.name: Initial Consultation (Online)
services.short: A comprehensive online consultation with herbal prescriptions and nutritional guidance.

services.name: Repeat Consultation (Online)
services.short: A follow-up session to review progress and adjust your wellness plan.

services.name: Gong Fu Tea Ceremony
services.short: Premium tea prepared with precision, for mindfulness and deep relaxation.

services.name: Private Gong Fu Tea Ceremony
